msg: I would not recommend just alternating between k and s. I would recommend trying each of the gnomes of all colors, see which one of each set gets you more points, or ignore the one that gives you 0 points. If the gnome starts going down a lot in value, try switching to the other one. Continue to ignore it if it gives you zero. It seems like the values of each gnome changes between rounds, so keep this in mind. I repeated the gnomes I should or shouldn't do once I figured it out in like a song, I don't know if that will help you or not.
